description: This file defines multiple custom exception classes for a software project, primarily extending openai exceptions and adding specific attributes and behaviors related to the 'litellm' framework. It includes error classes for various API errors, network errors, validation errors, and custom exceptions for guardrails and budgeting, used within the litellm project.

classes.name: AuthenticationError
classes.description: Custom exception extending openai.AuthenticationError, with additional attributes and string representations,

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Custom exception extending openai.NotFoundError, with extra context attributes.

classes.name: BadRequestError
classes.description: Base class for 400 errors, extended by specific error types, with additional debugging info.

classes.name: UnprocessableEntityError
classes.description: Error class for 422 responses, with extra attributes.

classes.name: Timeout
classes.description: Timeout error class with additional attributes for debugging and retry info.

classes.name: PermissionDeniedError
classes.description: 403 error class extending openai.PermissionDeniedError.

classes.name: RateLimitError
classes.description: 429 error class with additional context and custom string methods.

classes.name: ContextWindowExceededError
classes.description: 400 error for context window exceeded, extending BadRequestError.

classes.name: RejectedRequestError
classes.description: 400 error class for guardrail-related rejections, with request data.

classes.name: ContentPolicyViolationError
classes.description: 400 error for content policy violations, providing detailed message transformations.

classes.name: InternalServerError
classes.description: 500 error class with extra attributes and formatted string representations.

classes.name: ServiceUnavailableError
classes.description: 503 error class with debugging and retry attributes.

classes.name: BadGatewayError
classes.description: 502 error class for bad gateway responses.

classes.name: APIError
classes.description: Error class for invalid API responses, with status code and request context.

classes.name: APIConnectionError
classes.description: Error class for connection issues with request details.

classes.name: APIResponseValidationError
classes.description: Error for response validation failures, with raw response and schema info.

classes.name: OpenAIError
classes.description: Basic wrapper for openai's OpenAIError to include provider info.

classes.name: UnsupportedParamsError
classes.description: 400 error for unsupported parameters, with context.

classes.name: BudgetExceededError
classes.description: Simple exception for budget overrun, with cost info.

classes.name: MockException
classes.description: Test exception implementing openai.APIError, used for testing.

classes.name: LiteLLMUnknownProvider
classes.description: Exception for missing LLM provider info.

classes.name: GuardrailRaisedException
classes.description: General exception for guardrail intervention.

classes.name: BlockedPiiEntityError
classes.description: Exception for blocked entity detection.

classes.name: MidStreamFallbackError
classes.description: Error class for fallback scenarios during streaming, with detailed attributes.

classes.name: GuardrailInterventionNormalStringError
classes.description: Exception to return a normal string from guardrail intervention.
